items.t: North Vancouver real estate market stats

faq.a: The District of North Vancouver shore along Dollarton Highway on Burrard Inlet, between Maplewood Flats at the west end and Deep Cove to the east, taking in Whey-ah-Wichen (Cates Park) at 4141 Dollarton Highway and the Tsleil-Waututh Nation reserve shoreline.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Dollarton address?
faq.a: No public school inside Dollarton is confirmed. The schools beside the area are Cove Cliff Elementary (1818 Banbury Road) and Seycove Secondary (1204 Caledonia Avenue) in Deep Cove and Seymour Heights Elementary (2640 Carnation Street) to the north-west; catchments are address-based — check the exact address with SD44.

faq.q: What buses run on Dollarton Highway?
faq.a: Routes 211, 212 and 215 all run along Dollarton Highway to Phibbs Exchange, and some 211 trips continue over the Ironworkers Memorial Bridge to Burrard Station.

faq.q: What shoreline risks affect Dollarton waterfront homes?
faq.a: The port authority states the Cates Park shoreline is eroding and likely to worsen with sea level rise and climate change; District Schedule B creek, slope and wildfire permit areas can also apply, the District's flood levels are modelled to a 2100 horizon plus 0.6 m, and waterfront principal buildings need a 7.6 m setback from the Ocean Natural Boundary Line.
